prose.subject: Vendor Payout Account Update and Invoice INV-86795
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to inform you of a recent administrative update regarding our vendor payout structures at Upwell Security.

To streamline our financial operations and ensure better tracking, we have recently added a new payout account: 0x09e681d404e78c7681e236fb254fd606503cd79b. This account has been officially linked to our domain, upwell-security.example, to verify its authenticity for future transactions. Please update your records accordingly for any upcoming settlements.

Additionally, please find attached the invoice INV-86795 for your review. The total amount due is 4837.48 USDC. This covers the services rendered during the previous billing cycle. We kindly request that you process this payment at your earliest convenience.

If you have any questions regarding the new account details or the attached invoice, please do not hesitate to reach out. We appreciate your continued partnership and prompt attention to this matter.

Best regards,

Rafael Varga
Upwell Security
